_doc: DIE-S81-51/RF-G 11-03 RE-FORM (OWNER TWO-STRIKES / SAFE FORMS) of dsdv_eng_rr_e (S81-063, eng__t1, plan_h2_2249 unchanged: outline 410.4x466.56, pins clkm5_1101). (1) hx_res half-cycle seam (sender = dsdv_eng_rr_h0/h1 column negedge res_n face flops; contract half_cycle_inputs max (1-0.2)T = 666.4, min 0.5T-tol = 376.5): the 64x512 SRAM column sat on the S face over hx_res pins x 211.7-341 (~440 bits, pin->res_c ~88 um around the macro, 350 ps); the SRAM/row column moves up (5 gaps 10.824 -> 8.664, the u_wl -> u_h channel kept at 10.824, row_o fixed) so a 10.8-um S band is free and every res_c face flop sits at its pin; HXL=1 landing stage res_c -> res_c2 (full-cycle hop to the strap muxes, +1 ck on hres inside the hdone hold window, 0 cycles at ports). (2) u_xq fck -> vo_a/vo_b (fanout chain + 276*f offset shifter, -176 ps): OT_S81ENG_XQ_OHSEL registered one-hot rung select (PATH-S81/ENG2 10-25 miter, 0 cycles). util 0.45, regional taps 2x2 (~4.2k sinks / entry).
